caseName: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. City of Denver
caseNameFull: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Company v. City and County of Denver
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Colorado.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil Co., 250 U. S. 394. See Chicago v. Dempcy, 250 U. S. 651. Mr. Milton Smith and Mr. Charles R. *546Brock for plaintiffs in error. Mr, J. A. Marsh and Mr. Norton Montgomery for defendant in error.
